snippet.title: Proxy Project Ouroboros Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
My game is officially out now! please check out my Steam Store:
store.steampowered.com/app/3882470/Proxy_Project_Ouroboros/

Here's the trailer for my game, with the help of my brother  @Blaze_Redraw_YT   who edited all the raw footage so I could put it all together, If you'd like to see special gameplay footage of it you guys are welcome to check out  @Blaze_Redraw_YT  's channel and  @burkadaburkada  's channel as they will be uploading unique Beta testing footage of their playtests when the game comes out.

I really hope you guys can really enjoy my game, I made it for people to have fun sharing time with someone close and for single players to enjoy playing something that feels different yet nostalgic, if you enjoy it you're welcome to follow my channel as more games are coming and I would love to see how many people are interested in my games, please share this trailer to as many people as you can so it can reach those who want to play it and to support me as a developer. :D
